children: shares climbed about 3% Tuesday after the Chinese technology company laid out plans for a much larger AI model and introduced a new in-house processor.

The company said its next-generation model could reach 5 trillion to 10 trillion parameters, a measure of the number of learned variables used by an AI system. That would put the project well above Alibaba's current flagship Qwen model.

Alibaba also unveiled the Zhenwu V900 through its T-Head semiconductor unit. The processor is designed to deliver three times the performance of its predecessor and is scheduled to enter mass production in the first quarter of 2027.

The hardware push is tied to a broader expansion of Alibaba's computing infrastructure. Alibaba Cloud plans to take its global data-center capacity beyond 20 gigawatts by 2032, while the company continues developing its AI models and proprietary chips.

The moves come as Chinese technology companies seek greater control over AI computing amid U.S. restrictions on advanced processors. Alibaba's latest plans point to a strategy spanning chips, models and cloud infrastructure rather than relying on a single layer of the AI stack.

title: Alibaba Shares Jump After Unveiling New AI Chip
